anchor_value: USD-denominated cost columns in source schedule

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments (1) Non-Controlled, Non-Affiliated Investments | Industry | Reference Rate Spread (4) | Interest Rate (5) | Maturity Date | Par Amount/ Shares | Cost | Fair Value | Percentage of Net Assets

rationale: FX03 flags cost_currency as not USD, but the artifact value is UNIT_USD and the raw investment schedule presents cost and fair value as dollar-denominated columns. Representative table 11 row 4 and the table 12 total both show dollar signs for cost/fair value, so the source supports USD rather than a non-USD cost currency. The defect is in the check's treatment of the internal UNIT_USD token, not in the extracted holding value.
